//Lookup: Base URL of the data API. Not secret. Note this is the *container host* when the API runs in compose (http://api:8080), not localhost -- localhost inside the agent container is the agent.
//Jwt: ServiceSecret is intentionally blank. Supply it as Jwt__ServiceSecret so it never sits in a file under the web root. It must match the API's Jwt:ServiceSecret.
//Model: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. BaseUrl is the API root including /v1; the provider appends /chat/completions.

Model.//ApiKey: Blank on purpose. Supply MODEL__ApiKey as an environment variable.

//Conversation: Where the SQLite history lives. Relative resolves against the application directory, which is read-only under IIS and not where you want state in a container -- set Conversation__DatabasePath to a mounted volume.
